adapter_architecture.discovery: region/conference member links + federal-registry institution site -> ownership chain (host_discovery)
adapter_architecture.programme: governing-body/region listing -> PROGRAMME pages (current season only; prior season = history)
adapter_architecture.roster: entity-owned roster page (Presto/Sidearm/custom) -> ROSTER page or REFUSAL
adapter_architecture.staff: entity-owned staff page -> COACH page (printed email only, never inferred) or REFUSAL; never promoted in 8A
adapter_architecture.safety: refusePage: blocked/incomplete, old season, wrong sport, staff in roster, shared root, institution mismatch, foreign redirect, zero records, count collapse
adapter_architecture.transport: system curl (Node fetch is WAF-challenged); one retry after 60 s then BLOCKED; 1 worker, 6 s spacing
adapter_architecture.writes: adapters write nothing; integrity:gather opens the DB read-only; integrity:refresh --stage writes refresh_batches/refresh_observations only
